name: Ollama
description: Models in Ollama: what is on disk and in memory; start Claude Code or Codex on one, chat, unload, pull, remove.

list.command:
api=http://127.0.0.1:11434/api
curl -sf -m 1 $api/version >/dev/null || ollama ps >/dev/null 2>&1
tags=$(curl -sf -m 3 $api/tags) || { print -u2 "Ollama doesn't answer on 127.0.0.1:11434. Open the Ollama app, then try again."; exit 1; }
ps=$(curl -sf -m 3 $api/ps)
caps=$(print -r -- $tags | jq -r '.models[].name' | while read -r m; do
  curl -sf -m 3 $api/show -d "$(jq -nc --arg m $m '{model: $m}')" | jq -c --arg m $m '{($m): (.capabilities // [])}'
done | jq -sc 'add // {}')
jq -nc --argjson t "$tags" --argjson p "$ps" --argjson c "$caps" --arg s ${setting:editor.suggestionModel} '
  def size: if . >= 1e9 then "\(. / 1e8 | round / 10) GB" else "\(. / 1e6 | round) MB" end;
  def words: [.[] | select(. != "completion") | if . == "insert" then "fill-in" else . end] | join(", ");
  ($p.models // [] | map({(.name): .size_vram}) | add // {}) as $mem
  | $t.models | map(
      .name as $n | ($mem[$n]) as $m
      | {name: $n, loaded: ($m != null),
         title: ($n | split("/") | last | sub("-GGUF"; "")),
         tools: (($c[$n] // []) | index("tools") != null),
         subtitle: ([ (if $n == $s then "Code suggestions" else empty end),
                      (if $m != null then "In memory \($m | size)" else (.size | size) end),
                      (($c[$n] // []) | words | select(. != "")) ] | join(" · "))})
  | sort_by((.loaded | not), (.title | ascii_downcase)) | .[] | .state = (if .loaded then "loaded" else "disk" end)'
list.title: ${title}
list.subtitle: ${subtitle}

toolbar.title: Pull Model…
toolbar.terminal: printf "Model to pull (names on ollama.com/search): "; read -r m && [ -n "$m" ] && ollama pull "$m"
